summary.name: SubEthaEdit
summary.one_liner: SubEthaEdit is a free, open-source macOS text and code editor known for real-time collaborative editing over a local network or the internet.
use_cases: collaborative note taking or meeting minutes
writing articles or creative writing with others
using as a unix default editor from the command line
summary.what_it_does: SubEthaEdit lets multiple people edit the same document live, connecting to others on the local network or via a shared link if port forwarding is enabled. It supports block editing across multiple lines, multiple views of one document, and search and replace using regex flavors from simple shell to Ruby style. It ships with syntax modes for about 22 languages, including HTML, Markdown, Python and Go, plus autocomplete based on open texts. A command-line tool named see lets it act as a default unix editor, and it supports AppleScript and scripting modes.
notable: Real-time collaborative editing with follow mode and change highlighting
Blockedit for editing multiple lines at once with option-click
Command-line tool 'see' for use as a unix default editor
Distributed under the MIT license and developed as open source
caveats: Collaboration over the internet requires enabling port forwarding; otherwise it works on the local network
Page mentions Mojave dark mode support, so it is oriented to macOS versions around Mojave and later
